download.title: Let Classly keep count for you
download.text: Mark each class in one tap and see these numbers for every subject, all semester. Free, offline, no account.

hub.title: Free Attendance Calculators for Students · Classly
hub.description: Free attendance calculators: your attendance percentage, how many classes you can bunk, the 75% rule and how many classes you need to recover.
hub.intro: Quick answers to the questions students ask most about attendance. No sign-up, nothing stored: every calculation runs in your browser.

standing.title: Where do I stand?
standing.hint: Count every class held so far, including the ones you missed.

plan.title: Planning a whole semester?
plan.hint: If you know how many classes a subject will have in total.

whatif.title: What if I miss more classes?
whatif.hint: See your percentage after missing the next few classes.

recover.title: Can I still make it by the end of term?
recover.hint: Add how many classes of this subject are left this semester.
